ody.text: The Mirari appears in Otaria a century after the Invasion, found by Chainer in a ruined manor's basement, and he resists its call and gives it to the First as a tournament prize.
Lieutenant Kirtar takes it as his prize after the Krosan dragon is killed, and in trying to use it he is corrupted and crystallizes much of the Order's citadel, killing Captain Pianna.
Emperor Aboshan then pours mana into it, flooding the north of Otaria and destroying his capital and himself.

Chainer is driven mad by it and dies giving it to Kamahl, who attaches it to his sword and tries to unite the Pardic barbarians by force, until he plants it in Krosa, where it mutates the inhabitants.

tor.text: The Mirari pulses like a dead sun in the Cabal's vault, spreading darkness over Otaria, after Chainer finds it outside Cabal City and hands it to the First.
At the Mirari games, an Order attack infuriates Chainer, who unleashes carnage, and the Mirari overwhelms him when his healing goes wrong.
Chainer begs Kamahl to kill him, and Kamahl does, taking the Mirari as promised.

jud.text: The Mirari's magic transforms the Krosan Forest and its inhabitants, but first Kamahl keeps it safe from others and from himself, keeping his promise to a dying Chainer.

Under its influence he returns home and tries to take all the tribes under his dictatorship, then impales his sister Jeska with the Mirari-sword, leaving an incurable wound, and resolves to be rid of it.
He strikes down Laquatus with the sword and leaves it in the ground, where the Mirari pours energy into Krosa, mutating creatures and plants across Otaria.
Karn reveals the Mirari's origins and takes it back to Argentum.

ons.text: The Mirari's call changes all the centaurs who hear it and gives birth to Silvos, who is thrust out of his homeland and finds purpose in the pits.
Kamahl moves to the Krosan Forest with the Mirari and becomes a druid of Krosa, while its power begins mutating the forest's residents, growing some to gigantic proportions.
Every day, Order clerics contain as much of its energy as possible to delay Otaria's demise.

scg.text: Kamahl once again feels the full force of the Mirari's pull, though he has learned much since the last time.
Guided by Balthor's ghost he retrieves the sword from Laquatus's corpse, and he masters the Mirari only by slaying Balthor's phantom in a rage.
Karona learns the Mirari's nature from Lord Macht, takes the sword at Averru, and is finally struck down when Sash and Waistcoat drive the blade through her.
